tagline: An AI assistant that never lets the AI do the math
live.unavailable: Demo server is currently unavailable. Please refresh later.
foot.main: Replays of records generated by CI in scripted mode (no API key). Deterministic tools compute every number; the LLM writes none.
foot.live: This is live dialogue connected to real calculation services and Vertex AI Gemini. All numbers come from deterministic tools; the LLM does no math.
foot.legal: An unofficial fan project for Wuthering Waves and Mushoku Tensei. Mortgage results are example calculations, not financial advice. The Mushoku Tensei data was checked against the original by the author.
foot.content: Questions, answers and messages in the records are the program's actual Japanese input/output and are shown as is; translations are added for reference.
evals.intro: CI runs the evals in scripted mode (no API key) every time. The scripts deliberately include replies where the LLM writes numbers itself or follows injected instructions, to check that the verifier and gateway still stop them. Evals with real Claude are run locally by hand (not done yet).
live.intro: Ask questions live with real calculation services. Real LLMs follow cost caps (daily {daily} USD, monthly {monthly} USD).
live.scriptedNote: Scripted mode does not read the question; it replays the script in order (for reproducibility).
live.authDesc: Replay and Evals are open for public viewing. Live interaction with Vertex AI Gemini requires an access password.
